title: Account dashboard / worktable

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Place interface behavior in an ordinary working setting because product relevance becomes clearer through use.
strategic_value: Balances and a textured header on a phone among salon tools can connect Wise’s financial functions with everyday work.
demonstration: A phone lies diagonally among nail files, polish and tools; its account dashboard cycles balances and a colorful header while the photographic scene remains fixed.
practical_value: Compare how much brand expression belongs in the header while account information stays legible.
